text:
Maya Chen: heads-up — planning announce Thurs 9/18 10:00am PT. need changelog link, docs anchor, short bench blurb, and webinar CTA. who can take eng handoff?
Samira Khan: I can draft hero copy and webinar CTA. need final bench numbers and the canonical docs URL.
Alex Rivera: I’ll own the changelog publish. propose changelog freeze Wed 5pm PT, docs live Wed 11:59pm.
Jordan Patel: works for eng. will avoid codenames in public notes.
Linh Tran: tagging announce-bot to schedule rollout. announce-bot: please queue canary at announce time with 60m watch.
announce-bot: canary scheduled for 2025-09-18T10:00:00-07:00, watch 60m. notify: #eng-oncall #eng-sre.
Samira Khan: marketing rounding plan: hero line, 2-sentence bench blurb, tweet, and signup modal with UTM + hidden lead_tier field for routing. we’ll need sample field names from eng (account_id, inferred_region, plan_hint).
Alex Rivera: fields available: account_id, inferred_region, plan_hint. will publish docs at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/1777 and anchor #changelog by Wed 23:45 PT.
Jordan Patel: bench context: g5.12x, seq_len=1024, batch=16, warm cache. p99 down 17%, token cost down 22% with prefix caching + quant-B. single-token latency unchanged.
Samira Khan: marketing will state: "~17% lower p99 latency; ~22% reduced token cost." will include exact test setup in notes.
Maya Chen: inbound routing: route Enterprise leads (company_size>50) to SDR-Enterprise; edu/gov to Partnerships. Samira add `lead_tier` JS and pass to HubSpot.
Samira Khan: will do and include UTM: utm_source=announce&utm_campaign=release1777. CTA: "Sign up for the 9/20 deep-dive" -> https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=announce&utm_campaign=release1777
Jordan Patel: rollout plan: 0->5% at t0, 25% at +30m, 100% at +90m if metrics ok. fallback: `fallback_policy: revert_on_error(1.4x)`.
Maya Chen: final checklist: Alex drop docs link here when live; Jordan share canary playbook link; Samira post blog + social by Wed noon for review.
Alex Rivera: will confirm docs link here when live.
Samira Khan: aiming for Wed 12:00 PT drafts. ping me for last-minute number changes. :rocket:
Maya Chen: thanks — great sync. we’ll reconfirm Mon morning for a quick pulse. :thumbsup:
